Read the live function body of crm.ingest_whatsapp_message: phone normalised to '+'||digits only; lead found only by (org, source='whatsapp', source_ref='wa:'+phone); no email/name/fuzzy search; no existing-client or lost-lead lookup beyond the same-phone thread; no outcome enum. SELECT crm.contacts where phone !~ '^\+[0-9]{6,20}$' = 0 rows locally.
known_bug: (1) Only exact normalised PHONE identity exists for live inbound; email/name/source are not normalised or compared; none of the five spec outcomes exists as a value - NEW_IDENTITY vs EXISTING_LEAD is implicit in ON CONFLICT, EXISTING_CLIENT is never detected (a client's known phone creates/continues a lead thread, the contact's client_account_id is ignored), REACTIVATED_LEAD is not an outcome: a 'disqualified' lead that writes again stays 'disqualified' (only an activity row and lead.returned event, nobody subscribes), POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_REVIEW exists only as the same-contact heuristic in the list flag and as 'probable/conflict' in the bulk WhatsApp-export importer, never at inbound time. (2) Quick-Create stores phone exactly as typed (no E.164), so a manually created lead for '98765 43210' and a later WhatsApp inbound '+919876543210' become two contacts and two leads with no flag (flag keys on same contact_id). Email lookup is case-sensitive (email.eq) while the unique index is lower(email): a same-email different-case create fails with 'Could not create the contact' instead of reusing the contact (read from code, not executed). (3) createLead builds the PostgREST .or() filter by string-interpolating raw email/phone (service.ts ~1305) - unescaped commas/parentheses in input alter the filter (read from code; low exploitability because caller is an authenticated internal user with lead.write). (4) merge_leads refuses whenever EITHER lead has any opportunity, so duplicates with deals can never be merged. Never auto-merge: TRUE (merge is manual, owner only) - this part of the rule is met.
blocker: No identity-resolution service with the five outcomes; business must define 'existing client' and 'reactivated lead' semantics (ADM-05 says one lead per person forever and a returning client gets a new deal on the same lead).
risk: Duplicate leads/contacts across channels; a lost lead re-enquiring is not re-opened; a repeat client is treated as a new lead by the agent; history is preserved but not surfaced as an identity decision.
required_fix: Add a deterministic identity resolver (normalise E.164 + lower(email) + name token match, search client_accounts/contacts, lost/disqualified leads) with the five outcomes persisted on the inbound event, 'possible duplicate' queued for human review, and a subscriber for lead.returned that reopens or notifies; normalise phone in createLead.
validation_method: Live-DB verifier with same person across phone formats/email case/channels; assert outcome value and that no auto-merge happens.
notes: Prior audit 1.2 PARTIAL 'never auto-merges, manual merge only, same-contact only' - CONFIRMED on current main. NEEDS_BUSINESS_CLARIFICATION: ADM-05 'one lead per person forever' vs the spec's REACTIVATED_LEAD/EXISTING_CLIENT outcomes.
